name: Suspended Palaces
game_text:
Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 <culture>Dwarven</culture> tokens here.
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: Discard this condition or remove a <culture>Dwarven</culture> token from here to stack the top card of your draw deck on a <culture>Dwarven</culture> condition that has a card stacked on it.
